;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in Europe]]
**An officer fatally shoots a man in [[Cornellà]], [[Province of Barcelona|Barcelona]], [[Spain]], after he storms into a [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] police station with a knife. Police are treating the incident as an attempted terrorist attack. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-45244739 (BBC)]
*Suspected [[Boko Haram]] militants raid and burn the village of Mailari in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], killing six people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45243523 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Me Too movement]]
**American actor [[Jimmy Bennett]] accuses Italian actress [[Asia Argento]] of having sexual relations with him when he was 17 years old and then paying him $380,000 to keep silent. [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/asia-argento-paid-sexual-assault-accuser-report-1135872 (''The Hollywood Reporter'')] 
*[[2018 MTV Video Music Awards]]
**[[Camila Cabello]] wins Artist of the Year and "[[Havana (Camila Cabello song)|Havana]]" wins Video of the Year in [[Radio City Music Hall]] at the [[MTV Video Music Award|MTV Video Music Awards]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/mtv-vma-awards-winners-2018-08-20-live-updates/ (CBS News)] [http://www.mtv.com/news/3073959/vma-2018-new-york-return/ (MTV)]
**Singer [[Madonna (entertainer)|Madonna]]'s speech invoking [[Aretha Franklin]] is criticized by singer [[Cynthia Erivo]] and draq queen [[Tatianna]] as self-centered. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/madonna-slammed-for-self-centered-vmas-tribute-to-aretha-franklin/ (CBS News)]

;Business and economy
*[[PepsiCo]] announces its intent to buy [[SodaStream]], a manufacturer of products for in-home [[soft drink]] production, for [[US$]]3.2 billion. The deal awaits approval by regulators. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45244759 (BBC)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[Venezuelan bolívar|Venezuelan bolívar fuerte]] is replaced with the "[[Sovereign Bolivar]]" in an attempt to curb inflation. [[Venezuela]] announces that the new currency will be linked to the [[petro (currency)|petro]], a form of [[cryptocurrency]] operated by the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45245479 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Yosemite National Park]] officials say the [[Ferguson Fire]] in [[California]] is now fully contained. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45243518 (BBC)]
*Heavy floods in [[Civita, Calabria|Civita]], [[Italy]], kill 10 people and injure 23. [http://www.rainews.it/dl/rainews/articoli/calabria-torrente-raganello-canyon-piena-morti-escursionisti-d4e21838-b694-4726-90d2-522380464c0a.htm (Rai News)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**Eighty-nine [[South Korea]]ns are selected via lottery to be reunited for three days with [[North Korea]]n relatives they were separated from in the [[Korean War]] six decades earlier. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/20/South-North-Korea-families-reunite-decades-after-war/1611534740086/ (UPI)]

;Law and crime
*[[Arrests of Wa Lone and Kyaw Soe Oo]]
**The judge in the trial of two Reuters journalists jailed in [[Myanmar]] announces that he will deliver his verdict on August 27, in a test of press freedom in the country. The journalists were investigating mass graves at the village of [[Inn Din]] and the [[Inn Din massacre|massacre]] that took place there when they were arrested for allegedly obtaining "secret documents". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-journalists/reuters-journalists-face-verdict-next-week-on-myanmar-secrets-charges-idUSKCN1L50F2 (Reuters)]
*[[Crime in Chicago]], [[Gun violence in the United States]]
**Sixty-one people are shot over the weekend in [[Chicago]], including twelve in two mass shootings. Eight die, including five teenagers. Police arrest three people in connection with the shootings and 29 on other firearms charges, and seize 83 guns. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/chicago-gun-violence-at-least-60-shot-8-killed-in-another-deadly-weekend/ (CBS News)]
*[[Northern Iraq offensive (June 2014)]]
**Omar Ameen, a man arrested in [[Sacramento, California|Sacramento]] on suspicion of a 2014 Iraqi murder linked to the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]], faces a judge at an extradition hearing. He is denied bail. [https://sacramento.cbslocal.com/2018/08/20/omar-ameen-isis-bail/amp/ (CBS Sacramento)] [https://www.kcra.com/article/judge-accused-isis-member-to-be-held-without-bail-in-sacramento/22780409 (KCRA)]
*Two men are detained in [[Ankara]], [[Turkey]], after shots are fired at the United States embassy. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/shots-fired-gate-us-embassy-turkey-hurt-57278680 (ABC News)]
*An American woman shoots two employees at a food distribution plant in [[Houston, Texas]], killing one person and injuring the other, before killing herself. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/20/us/texas-workplace-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[South Africa|South African]] government begins the process of seizing land from white farm owners. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&objectid=12110366 (''NZ Herald'')]{{Dubious |Talk section name|date=August 2018}}
